dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Basquiat is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, he has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to thrash, flail, and snap while on leash. During intake it was reported that Basquiat snapped at the police. Basquiat is receptive to squeaky sounds. Medically, Basquiat has moderate to severe dental disease, a luxating patella, is underweight and matted.

Basquiat arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, he has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to thrash, flail, and snap while on leash. During intake it was reported that Basquiat snapped at the police. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
